text:
emily: Heads up - publishing our JS SDK broke the edge sample in a weird way. Vite app on Cloudflare and a Bun local run both import the package but end up pulling CJS runtime ("module.exports") and crash. TS defs also missing in editor. Anyone seen an exports/types mismatch?

lee: Which package.json exports block are we shipping? can you paste it?

emily: Minimal exports we pushed: 
```json
\"exports\": {
  \".\": {
    \"import\": \"./dist/esm/index.js\",
    \"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js\"
  },
  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"
}
\\n// no top-level \"types\" field, we relied on \"types\" inside output .d.ts only referenced by exports via TS 4.5 resolver
```

diego: Oof. Two problems: 1) older bundlers / Bun may not honor conditional exports the same as Node and will fall back oddly, 2) TypeScript/VSCode won't always pick up types unless you include a top-level \"types\" or a types entry in exports with the exact path.

thorn: Also remember that some ESM consumers (Cloudflare Workers) will choke if the published package still contains any CJS-style files or dynamic require shims — that can manifest as \"Unexpected token export\" or runtime type errors.

emily: Exactly what we saw in the edge sample: runtime throws because a helper file in dist still has `export default` but was imported as if it were CommonJS. Our build emits mixed outputs because our rollup config outputs both formats from the same source.

lee: Short term fixes we can push: 1) add a root-level `\"types\" : \"dist/index.d.ts\"` to the package.json, 2) make exports explicit for types: `\".\": { \"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\", ... }`, 3) add `\"module\"` field pointing to ESM entry for bundlers that prefer it.

diego: Long term we should pick one canonical pattern: either proper dual-package with `main` + `module` + `types` OR conditional exports that include `types` and subpath entries for `./edge` and `./node`. Eg: 
```json
\"exports\": {
  \".\": {
    \"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\",
    \"import\": \"./dist/esm/index.js\",
    \"require\": \"./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js\",
    \"node\": \"./dist/node/index.cjs.js\",
    \"edge\": \"./dist/edge/index.mjs\"
  }
}
```

thorn: For auth/retry semantics we also hit a divergence: edge consumers use global fetch, and our retry middleware (built around axios-like interceptors) never executes. The edge bundle ended up tree-shaking the middleware because different entrypoint. So token refresh didn't run.

emily: Right. In the sample the flow is: initial request -> 401 -> app expects SDK to refresh token and retry -> instead it surfaces error.

lee: Proposal: SDK provides a small runtime-agnostic adapter layer. Expose `createRequester({ fetch?: FetchFn })` and a `retryStrategy` hook. Default keeps old behavior in Node, but edge can pass `globalThis.fetch` and a handler that replays the auth flow. We'll document and include an edge example.

diego: Also add a CI smoke that installs the published tarball into the sample-app and runs a minimal worker harness (wrangler or equivalent). That would have caught this earlier.

ci-bot: publish-checker: npm pack -> install -> run smoke tests: FAILED (types missing, wrong entrypoint). See job 4821.

thorn: I'll open a tiny patch: add root-level `types`, add `exports[\".\"].types`, and a `dist/edge/` entry plus docs for esbuild/rollup to ensure no CJS code emitted in edge bundles. Will also add an example in samples/edge/README with esbuild config: `format: 'esm', target: 'es2022', bundle: true, platform: 'browser'`.

emily: Thanks. If we add `types` at root and explicit `types` in exports that should fix the editor. The runtime needs the explicit edge entry or a separate edge build.

lee: One more note: bump TS version in our SDK to >=4.5 and add `typesVersions` mapping for older tooling that uses path-based resolution. That will reduce editor complaints across monorepos.

emily: Great. I'll hold the sample-app PR until we have the publish patch so CI can validate the packed tarball. Appreciate the quick triage.

ci-bot: queued job 4822: pack+install+edge-smoke (pending).
